thread:
ana: FYI - after today's runtime CI build r3521 we rolled a 10% canary in us-central. Long-seq p95 up ~85ms, p99 up ~310ms vs our baseline. Can we triage before moving to 50%?
liam: Which benchmark and model? long vs short seq?
ana: long_seq against redwood-v2, run id: bench/2026-03-17/longseq-r3521. p50 nearly identical, tails are worse.
tara (infra): I'll pull the bench artifacts. Can someone paste the exact bench command used?
ana: ```
./infra/bench/run --suite=long_seq --model=redwood-v2 --build=r3521 --samples=250 --out=artifacts/longseq-r3521
```
bench-bot: Bench job available: https://ci.internal/bench/longseq-r3521 (artifacts uploaded)
liam: Starting heap sampling + alloc-hist on canary node now. If kv-cache cold-starts spiked, that could explain p95.
ana: Logs show a burst of small CUDA alloc/retries at 09:14:11, but no OOM. Also a notable increase in small host allocs.
opsbot: Reminder — default canary will auto-increase to 50% at 10:30 unless held.
tara (infra): Our rollout SLA breach trigger: p95 regression >50ms OR p99 >200ms. Current deltas exceed both; recommendation: HOLD and don't escalate.
devexp: Can we try a targeted revert of the new kernel-priority rule from r3521 in staging to compare? If that proves quick, we can patch without full rollback.
liam: Kernel-priority revert is relatively safe but may increase median latency. Fastest mitigation is rollback to r3510.
ana: I'm leaning rollback to r3510 to restore customer SLAs quickly. Requesting approvals: @tara, @liam, @sre-oncall
tara (infra): :thumbsup: roll back to r3510. I'll open rollback run and notify SRE.
sre-oncall: Oncall here — agree with hold+rollback. I'll prepare the rollback playbook and monitor health checks. We can cap to 5% if we need an intermediate step.
opsbot: :eyes: Auto-escalation paused; canary will not increase.
bench-bot: Alloc trace recommended post-rollback: rerun with `--alloc-trace --duration=10m`.
liam: Kicking nvprof + alloc-trace after rollback. Also will capture glibc malloc metrics.
ci-bot: Rollback started: deploy/rollback/r3510-322334100 (ETA ~2m)
ana: Capturing perf traces and logs now — uploading to https://artifacts.internal/trace/longseq-r3521
ci-bot: Rollback complete: deploy/rollback/r3510-322334167. Health checks passing.
tara (infra): Quick validation: p95 returned within noise (+9ms), p99 back to baseline. Holding at 10% until traces validated.
liam: Post-rollback run scheduled: `./infra/bench/run --suite=long_seq --model=redwood-v2 --build=r3510 --alloc-trace --samples=200 --duration=10m --out=artifacts/longseq-r3510-alloc`
devexp: Thanks folks. Next steps: 1) analyze alloc traces and nvprof, 2) test kernel-priority revert in staging, 3) run 1h long_seq at 10% with canary flags if traces look clean.
sre-oncall: I'll keep monitoring for 30m and will re-open if anything flares.
ana: Filing a follow-up ticket with artifacts and runbooks; will schedule a deeper profiler session tomorrow. Thanks all.
